toneNote: tone.weight scales a channel's videos in attention thresholds and comment sentiment (1 = full). hype: true also halves a video whose title is hype (caps, !!, CRAZY, INSANE, EXPLODE). Claim scoring is never weighted: every claim is scored the same and stays unverified until our data backs it.
podcastNote: channels[].podcast = { rss } turns on feed ingestion: <podcast:transcript> files from the publisher's own RSS only, no audio download. Local Whisper is not wired; add it only for a feed whose terms allow transcription. None of the tracked channels had its own podcast feed on 2026-10-12.
textRoutesNote: Routes per channel: (1) podcast RSS transcripts (channels[].podcast.rss), (2) X handles listed in textSources.x; the nightly cannot call X tools, so posts are not read yet, (3) description chapters and the creator's own comments, parsed every night, (4) blogs and newsletters by RSS when one exists. Patreon has no public feed and its terms bar scraping, so it is not read. YouTube captions and audio are never touched.
